description: Your monitors, newest first, with their settings, status (active or paused, and paused_reason: user, insufficient_credits, or webhook_failing), webhook (url, events, consecutive_failures, and last_delivery, the newest delivery with its status, as on monitor-get; never the secret), next_run_at, last_run, and totals (runs, items, spent_usd). Free. Returns { monitors, next_cursor }; next_cursor is null on the last page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same status filter when you page.
